about: Spells. aim: point (tap), line (drag; cost is per cell), drag (tap and hold to keep casting). cost = mana; cd = seconds before it can be cast again; tier = where it sits in the Grimoire (0 = known from the start). power grows with the spell's level (upgrades): radius and strength x (1 + 0.2 per level). color tints it. Read by js/sim/spells.js.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A ball of fire drops from the sky and bursts, lighting whatever can burn.

rain.name: Rain Cloud
rain.desc: A cloud drifts with the wind, soaking the ground and drowning fires.

earth.name: Raise Earth
earth.desc: Drag to push up a ridge of stone. Lava and water must flow round it.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.desc: A bolt from above. In water the shock runs through everything wet. Sand turns to glass.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: A falling star. Leaves a crater, a shower of burning rock and a lot of smoke.

frost.name: Frost Nova
frost.desc: A burst of cold: water freezes to ice, lava to obsidian, fires go out and creatures stiffen.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: The land greens: grass, seedlings, flowers. Burnt ground heals.

heal.name: Healing Light
heal.desc: Mends every creature in the light and puts out any fire it touches.

gale.name: Gale
gale.desc: Drag the way the wind should blow. Strong wind drives fire and smoke before it.

bless.name: Blessing
bless.desc: Creatures in the glow breed four times as fast.

quake.name: Quake
quake.desc: The ground shakes and splits. Walls crack, trees fall, everyone is thrown about.

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.desc: A rain cloud that throws lightning about as it goes.

spring.name: Wellspring
spring.desc: Water bubbles up from the ground, forever.

sinkhole.name: Sinkhole
sinkhole.desc: The ground drops away. Water pours in to fill it.

firewall.name: Wall of Fire
firewall.desc: Drag a line of flame. Nothing likes to cross it.

tornado.name: Whirlwind
tornado.desc: A twister that wanders, tearing up grass and flinging creatures. It carries fire if it meets some.

smite.name: Sunlance
smite.desc: A beam of sunlight. Huge harm to one spot, worst for the restless dead.

chain.name: Chain Lightning
chain.desc: A bolt that leaps from creature to creature.

shower.name: Meteor Shower
shower.desc: Stars rain down over a wide area for a few seconds.

volcano.name: Raise Volcano
volcano.desc: A mountain heaves up and lava pours from its top.

acidrain.name: Bile Rain
acidrain.desc: Green rain that eats stone and stings everything under it.

void.name: Void Orb
void.desc: A seed of nothing. It drinks in the land around it and drags creatures toward it.

fireflies.name: Fireflies
fireflies.desc: A swarm of little lights to brighten the night.

holyrain.name: Blessed Rain
holyrain.desc: Golden rain that heals what it falls on and drowns fire.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: A shining dome. Monsters cannot walk in; fire, lava, blasts and dragon breath stop at its skin.

missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
missiles.desc: Violet darts that seek the nearest foes around where you touch — even ones in the air.
